reviews.title: WARNING: Tremendous Payout Scam / Fake Review Hold Tactics
reviews.text:
This app has become a total scam. At first, they paid out in seconds to build trust, but it's clear that their budget is now low, and they are resorting to shady tactics to take advantage of people. They force you to watch an endless loop of annoying ads and harvest your data for days just to collect gems. But when you finally try to redeem, they send a broken Tremendous link that says, "Your reward needs to be reviewed by the sender." Then, they steal your coins from your balance, fail to send the gift card email, and completely ghost you on support emails. If I actually violated a policy, they should have banned my ID BEFORE I spent days earning the points. Instead, they let you watch their revenue-generating ads, take your coins, and lock your payout at the finish line hoping you will give up and start over. Do not trust this app! They are farming your time for ad money and keeping the rewards. At last now they have also stopped you from slotting unlimited times. If you have 500 slot coins, you will only slot 60 times per day so you won’t earn more gems to redeem soon.
Update: 
They changed the slot's highest price from 5k to 10k in the latest update and since then never seen 777. They didn’t just change the slot rewards but also block the 777 so no one gets 777 again just like the spin 100k which is also blocked, no one has ever had that.
